check_env_environment: run the sglang check_env.py script to print Python, PyTorch, CUDA, and package version information
get_package_versions: get a dictionary of installed package versions for sglang and its dependencies
get_device_info: get GPU device names and compute capabilities for all available CUDA devices
get_hypervisor_vendor: get the hypervisor vendor string from lscpu output
get_topology: get GPU topology information using nvidia-smi for Nvidia GPUs
